name: cra-readiness
description: Get products ready for the EU Cyber Resilience Act (Regulation 2024/2847). Four deterministic stdlib scripts: a scope classifier that sorts a portfolio into default, important class I/II and critical (Annex III/IV), blocks conformity routes Article 32 does not allow, checks support periods and names the CSIRT for Article 14 reports; an Article 14 clock for the 24h/72h/14-day/one-month deadlines live since 11 September 2026; an Annex I/II/VII gap check before the EU declaration of conformity; and an SBOM floor check for CycloneDX and SPDX. Ships cs-cra-officer agent, /cs-cra-readiness and /cs-cra-report commands, 3 cited references and an Article 14 runbook.
